title: Recently viewed
hints: Replace each `any` with a type parameter. `pushRecent` needs one, `<T>`, used for the list, the item and the result. `zip` has two unrelated inputs, so it needs two, `<A, B>`, and it returns an array of `[A, B]` tuples.

`pushRecent`: build a new array with the item first, followed by the old list without that item (`filter((x) => x !== item)`), then `slice(0, max)`. `zip`: loop up to `Math.min(as.length, bs.length)` and push `[as[i], bs[i]]`.

function pushRecent<T>(list: readonly T[], item: T, max: number): T[] { return [item, ...list.filter((x) => x !== item)].slice(0, max); }  function zip<A, B>(as: readonly A[], bs: readonly B[]): [A, B][] { … }
